## Change summary

Describe the scholarly clarification or code fix. Link the related issue, claim, case ID, or file.

## Research integrity

- [ ] This change does **not** silently rewrite the dated Zenodo v1.0.0 record or suggest the preprint is peer-reviewed.
- [ ] Scholarly claims are cited or marked as interpretation; case labels are not presented as empirical ground truth.
- [ ] I have permission to license my contribution under CC BY 4.0 (research/data/docs) or Apache 2.0 (software/tests), as applicable.
- [ ] I have not included personal data, credentials, or uncleared media.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant local tests and `python verify_release.py` after rebuilding the checksum manifest if artifact files changed.
- [ ] I checked documentation links and maintained the DOI for the original Zenodo release.
